root_causes.description: The product-catalog pod served nothing for the entire window: its server-span request rate is flat zero with no request or error logs, and its container CPU sits idle at ~0.001 cores versus ~0.281 for the healthy frontend. No restarts or K8s events were observed, indicating the pod/process was not handling traffic. As the central leaf dependency of frontend, checkout and recommendation, its loss produced the namespace-wide telemetry blackout and multi-second caller timeouts without application errors.

evidence.observed_value: request_rate=0.000 (mean/p50/p95/p99/max all 0.000) across the full window
evidence.expected_baseline: steady non-zero server request rate for the leaf dependency of frontend/checkout/recommendation
frontend=0.281 cores mean; a serving product-catalog should exceed ~0.01 cores
no errors expected; consistent with a dead/idle pod rather than one aborting requests

evidence.observed_value: [no logs found] — zero request or error log lines in the window
evidence.expected_baseline: regular request-handling log lines from a live product-catalog pod
Killing/Stopping or restart events if a pod kill occurred

evidence.observed_value: 20 traces, 0 with errors, p95_duration=16419ms; top spans user_get_ads 5000ms, user_browse_product 5001ms (trace 798b3b0326bd9dea)
evidence.expected_baseline: sub-second browse latency and frontend p95 well under 1s

root_causes.description: Alternative framing as a failing downstream dependency: product-catalog is unreachable so upstream callers (frontend, checkout, recommendation) stall on it. Evidence is the same missing product-catalog server spans combined with elevated upstream latency and a complete absence of recorded application errors.

evidence.observed_value: request_rate=0.000 — the dependency served nothing all window
evidence.expected_baseline: non-zero request rate for a reachable dependency

root_causes.description: Frontend shows a latency anomaly (5s to 16s spans) that is a downstream symptom of the product-catalog outage rather than an intrinsic fault; its error rate is zero and its CPU is normal.

evidence.observed_value: 20 traces, 0 with errors, p95_duration=16419ms; user_get_ads 5000ms, user_browse_product 5001ms, user_view_cart 1501ms (trace 15d1cee789a98d1b)

remediation_steps: Confirm product-catalog pod health and history: kubectl get pods -n otel-demo -l app.kubernetes.io/name=product-catalog and kubectl describe pod <product-catalog-pod> to inspect restart count, termination reason and last state.
Inspect whether the pod was killed (Killing/Stopping container) and whether a chaos/pod-kill fault is injected against product-catalog; stop the fault injection if present.
Restart/redeploy the product-catalog deployment and verify its server-span request rate returns to a non-zero baseline and container CPU rises off idle.
After recovery, validate that frontend/checkout/recommendation latency returns to sub-second and that namespace span telemetry resumes.
